backlogged.summary: In lib/eval.mjs, when the evaluator and security-reviewer both return usage_limit, only the first match (evaluator) is reported. This is harmless, but the security-reviewer's detail is dropped.

A usage_limit result from a claude call that has r.error set (spawn error or timeout) is never classified as usage_limit. This matches the contract, but a timeout whose partial stdout already held the limit wrapper is treated as a plain timeout.
